summary: axios 1.14.1 and 0.30.4 were malicious npm releases. They depended on plain-crypto-js 4.2.1, which ran from a postinstall script. Both axios versions and the dropper package were removed from the registry.
remediation: Remove axios 1.14.1, axios 0.30.4, and plain-crypto-js 4.2.0 or 4.2.1. Pin axios to a release that was not part of that incident, such as 1.14.0 or 0.30.3. Rotate credentials that were present on a machine that installed the bad release.
